sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (submitter John William Eppele, SIL Nepal). 2011. Change Request Number 2011-164: retire [pgy] Pongyong (adopted, effective 2012-02-03). Dallas: SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. States pgy is a 'ghost entry': 'Pongyong' is a Rai clan name (van Driem 2001:623); its only basis was a single questionnaire in Hansson's survey (Hansson 1988:20-21; 1991:76-77, 84-85), and Hansson himself hedged that it may be part of Saam [raq]. No linguistic description of any kind.
